clos.original_description: Employ artificial intelligence techniques to test hypothesis in Python, and apply a machine learning model combining Numpy, Pandas, and Scikit-Learn
clos.enriched_description: Employ artificial intelligence techniques to test hypothesis in Python, and apply a machine learning model combining Numpy, Pandas, and Scikit-Learn. The scope includes Introduction to Data Science and scikit-learn in Python; Introduction to Python Programming for Hypothesis Testing; Creating a Hypothesis: Numpy, Pandas, and Scikit-Learn; and Scikit-Learn Revisited: ML for Hypothesis Testing.

clos.original_description: Implement and evaluate machine learning models (neural networks, random forests, etc.) on scientific data in Python
clos.enriched_description: Implement and evaluate machine learning models (neural networks, random forests, etc.) on scientific data in Python. The scope includes Machine Learning Models in Science, Before the AI: Preparing and Preprocessing Data, and Advanced AI: Neural Networks and Decision Trees.

clos.original_description: Implement simple neural network models and describe the differences between Neural Networks and Random Forests
clos.enriched_description: Implement simple neural network models and describe the differences between Neural Networks and Random Forests. The scope includes Neural Networks and Random Forests, Exploring Random Forests, and Final Project: Comparing Models to predict pedal width.

clos.original_description: Analyzing genome sequences to find similarities and identify target subsequences using predctive models
clos.enriched_description: Analyzing genome sequences to find similarities and identify target subsequences using predictive models. The scope includes Comparing genome sequences and PCA on genome sequence and Predicting Bit Score to find sequences matches.
